messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — planning a short mirror-write window for users.last_seen migration (ADD COLUMN + backfill ~2M rows). Target window: Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC. Who's deploying, who's running smoke, and what's the rollback readiness? Need DB slot reservation and pause of background writers. @Priya can you own the deploy? /cc @Samir for backfill script sanity check.

Priya Rao: I can take deploy and be on-call for the window. Confirming the window Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC works for me. Will coordinate with infra and be online in this thread during the run.

Samir Patel: Backfill script validated on staging and dry-run looks good. Using chunked updates with key ranges to avoid long transactions. Example chunk SQL: ```UPDATE users SET last_seen_ts = created_at WHERE last_seen_ts IS NULL AND id > $start AND id <= $end;``` We'll run 100k-row chunks with a small sleep between chunks. Recommend stopping background digest workers: `systemctl stop user-digest` and pausing async writers.

Maria Lopez: Smoke checklist I'll run 30m before window: 1) schema apply dry-run on canary DB 2) small backfill 10k rows 3) app reads new column + end-to-end check 4) perf baseline for user endpoints. I'll post results here.

InfraBot: Deployment job scheduled: `deploy/infra/2479991111` by Priya Rao at 2026-03-24T03:30:00Z. Link: https://deploys.redwood.example/2479991111

Alex Chen: Rollback plan notes: primary rollback is feature-flag based — toggle off writes to `users:last_seen_write` and stop backfill workers. Avoid schema DROP in rollback unless absolutely necessary. Secondary: route writes to fallback service and replay later. Priya, confirm you'll run the feature-flag toggle as first action on any failure.

Priya Rao: Confirmed. Rollback drill: 1) `ff toggle users:last_seen_write=false` 2) `pkill -f backfill_job` 3) re-enable workers after assessment. I'll add these commands to the runbook.

Samir Patel: Also plan to capture pre/post counts: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE last_seen_ts IS NULL;` before window and after each chunk (summary). I'll produce an expected delta file so we can detect off-by-one. Also suggest setting a simple SLO: p95 user get endpoints <2s during the window; abort if violated.

Maria Lopez: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary and post perf numbers. If we see regressions I'll call abort immediately.

Alex Chen: Quick question — who has DB slot ownership and can reserve it? @Samir?

Samir Patel: I requested a DB slot from the DB team — they replied approved and reserved slot 12. I'll confirm allocation 15m before window.

InfraBot: Reminder: 30-minute preflight at 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z — runbooks updated: https://confluence.redwood.example/migrations/last-seen-backfill

Priya Rao: I'll be online in this thread during the window and will post live status. If nothing else, plan to roll forward and close out with a summary post within an hour after completion.
